P001.note: Debate on the proposed article introducing economic and social rights, with support for States acting within their possibilities (art. 22's realisation clause).

P075.note: Vote on the final paragraph of the general Article 1 (resources, colonial territories), not education.

P076.note: Wording 'present and voting' in the election article's second sentence (borderline).

P077.note: Chang on the new article on right to social order and its link to duties.

P078.note: Article on juridical personality not limited to nationality or stateless persons.
